cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 chassis, Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 with prominent buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine @4, no reinforcing strong anionic (C3, C4, C1). Coco-Glucoside @14 is post-fragrance and recorded only.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: several light routes - a prominent humectant cluster (Urea @3, Glycerin @5, Sodium Lactate @7, Panthenol @8) with a post-fragrance guar @17, Glycol Distearate @15 and weak refatters (Glyceryl Oleate @13, Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate @18, Lecithin @19). C2 not met (no prominent silicone or payload lipid). The only slip agent is post-fragrance, so low is the realistic neighbor.

weightPotential.depositionLoad: light - trace post-fragrance guar and weak refatters
weightPotential.persistence: low - no silicone, lipid or protein
weightPotential.counterevidence: Two families present on paper (cationic + weak refatter).
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Only a trace guar and weak refatters; humectants are context, not deposition.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate (W2): the guar is listed after the fragrance and after the sub-1 % actives (Panthenol @8, Allantoin @9, Tocopherol @10), the other family is only weak refatters plus humectants, and a buffered SLES reset faces these light routes.
weightPotential.rationale: Low: trace guar + weak refatters (6.6, W2).

careDirection.limitation: Formula-only; conditioning support is late and light

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Prominent comfort routes (Urea, Panthenol, Allantoin) plus a dandruff active point to a scalp role if positioned
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: PROVISIONAL (formula-only): no claim direction; verdict moisture_supported; comfort routes and Piroctone Olamine present. Placeholder general until claims.

usageRole.rationale: PROVISIONAL: default regular; treatment if a moderate/high dandruff claim (U3); frequent possible with frequency wording (U2).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: PROVISIONAL: CSA formula half met via listed prominent routes Urea @3, Panthenol @8, Allantoin @9 (comfort) and Glycerin @5, Sodium Lactate @7 (humectant); MB excluded (prominent SLES). Cleansing moderate (no strong counter-signal). targeted needs SC1 positioning.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Supported: Piroctone Olamine @22 in the complete INCI; position is not checked (Section 11). Its preservative-zone position may mean it serves as a preservative - the claim decides the dandruff path (R17.3).

uncertainties: Identity confidence moderate in the packet.
Piroctone Olamine @22 sits among preservatives; recognized regardless (Section 11), dandruff path depends on claims.
